name: @semestra/api
description: pnpm wrapper so the Python backend takes part in root scripts; the real project is pyproject.toml

scripts.lint: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.format: uv run ruff check --fix . && uv run ruff format .
scripts.openapi: uv run semestra openapi > ../../packages/api-client/openapi.json && uv run semestra capabilities > ../../packages/api-client/capabilities.json
